As adv., τὸ τ., the third time: [[r:MRK.14.41|Mrk 14:41]], [[r:JHN.21.17|Jhn 21:17]]; anarth., τρίτον, a third time, [[r:LUK.23.22|Luk 23:22]], [[r:JHN.21.14|Jhn 21:14]], [[r:2CO.12.14|2Co 12:14 13:1]]; in enumerations, thirdly, [[r:1CO.12.28|1Co 12:28]]; ἐκ τ., a third time, [[r:MAT.26.44|Mat 26:44]] (AS)

G5157.root: from an apparently primary τρέπω to turn
senses: (τρέπω), a turning: esp. of the revolution of heavenly bodies, figuratively, [[r:JAS.1.17|Jas 1:17]] (see: ἀποσκίασμα).† (AS)

G5158.strongs: a turn, i.e. (by implication) mode or style (especially with preposition or relative prefix as adverb, like); figuratively, deportment or character
G5158.kjv: (even) as, conversation, (+ like) manner, (+ by any) means, way
senses: Of persons, manner of life, character (Hdt., Æsch., al.): [[r:HEB.13.5|Heb 13:5.]]† (AS)
to bear another's manners (R, txt., suffered he their manners): with accusative of person(s), [[r:ACT.13.18|Act 13:18]] (Rec., WH, R, txt.; ἐτροφο-, T, R, mg.).
= τροφοφορέω (which see), (see Kühner3, I, 276): Ac, l.with† (AS)

G5160.strongs: nourishment (literally or figuratively); by implication, rations (wages)

G5163.strongs: a track (as a wheel-rut), i.e. (figuratively) a course of conduct
senses: (τροχός), the track of a wheel, hence, a track, path: figuratively, [[r:HEB.12.13|Heb 12:13]] (LXX) † (AS)

G5164.strongs: a wheel (as a runner), i.e. (figuratively) a circuit of physical effects

G5165.root: neuter of a presumed derivative of uncertain affinity
senses: τρύβλιον (Rec. τρυβλίον), -ου, τό a bowl, dish: [[r:MAT.26.23|Mat 26:23]], [[r:MRK.14.20|Mrk 14:20]] (Hippocr., Aristoph., Pint., al.).† (AS)

G5166.root: from a derivative of τρύγω (to dry) meaning ripe fruit (as if dry)
senses: of that from which it is gathered, [[r:REV.14.19|Rev 14:19.]]† (AS)

G5167.strongs: akin to, but denoting a duller sound); a turtle-dove (as cooing)

G5168.root: from a derivative of τρύω (to wear away
G5168.strongs: akin to the base of, and); an orifice, i.e. needle's eye
senses: (τρύω, to wear away), = τρύμη, a hole: τ. ῥαφίδος, eye of a needle, [[r:MRK.10.25|Mrk 10:25.]]† SYN.: τρῆμα, τρύπημα (AS)

G5169.root: from a derivative of the base of [[w:G5168]]
G5169.strongs: an aperture, i.e. a needle's eye
senses: (τρυπάω, to bore) a hole: τ. ῥαφιδος, eye of a needle, [[r:MAT.19.24|Mat 19:24]] (WH, txt., τρῆμα).† SYN.: τρῆμα, τρυμαλιά (AS)
(τρυφή), to live daintily, luxuriously, to fare sumptuously: [[r:JAS.5.5|Jas 5:5]] (cf. ἐν-τρυφάω).† SYN.: σπαταλάω (which see), στρηνιάω (AS)

G5172.root: from θρύπτω (to break up or (figuratively) enfeeble, especially the mind and body by indulgence)

G5174.strongs: the Troad (or plain of Troy), i.e. Troas, a place in Asia Minor
senses: Τρῳάς (Rec. Τρω-), -άδος, ἡ Troas, a city near the Hellespont: [[r:ACT.16.8|Act 16:8, 11 20:5-6]], [[r:2CO.2.12|2Co 2:12]], [[r:2TI.4.13|2Ti 4:13]].† (AS)

G5176.root: probably strengthened from a collateral form of the base of [[w:G5134]] and [[w:G5147]] through the idea of corrosion or wear
G5176.strongs: or perhaps rather of a base of and through the idea of a craunching sound; to gnaw or chew, i.e. (generally) to eat
senses: prop., of animals, to gnaw, munch, crunch (Hom., al.).
Of men, to eat raw food, as vegetables, nuts, etc. (Hdt., al.).
In late vernacular, simply to eat (= ἐσθίω): [[r:MAT.24.38|Mat 24:38]], [[r:JHN.6.54|Jhn 6:54, 56-58 13:18]] (LXX ἐσθίων) (see Kennedy, Sources, 82, 155; MM, xxv).† (AS)

G5177.root: probably for an obsolete τύχω (for which the middle voice of another alternate τεύχω (to make ready or bring to pass) is used in certain tenses
G5177.strongs: akin to the base of through the idea of effecting; properly, to affect; or (specially), to hit or light upon (as a mark to be reached), i.e. (transitively) to attain or secure an object or end, or (intransitively) to happen (as if meeting with); but in the latter application only impersonal (with), i.e. perchance; or (present participle) as adjective, usual (as if commonly met with, with, extraordinary), neuter (as adverb) perhaps; or (with another verb) as adverb, by accident (as it were)
G5177.kjv: be, chance, enjoy, little, obtain, X refresh…self, + special
senses: to hit (opposite to ἁμαρτάνω, to miss the mark: Hom., Xen., al.).
of persons, to meet with, fall in with: absol., ptcp., ὁ τυχών, a chance person, anyone (Lat. quivis), οὐ τυχών, not common or ordinary, [[r:ACT.19.11|Act 19:11 28:2]];
of things, to reach, get, obtain: with genitive of thing(s) [[r:LUK.20.35|Luk 20:35]], [[r:ACT.24.3|Act 24:3 26:22 27:3]], [[r:2TI.2.10|2Ti 2:10]] [[r:HEB.8.6|Heb 8:6 11:35]].

Intrans., to happen; of things, to happen, chance, befall: impers., εἰ τύχοι, it may be, perhaps, [[r:1CO.14.10|1Co 14:10 15:37]]; so ptcp., τυχόν (old accusative absol.; see M, Pr., 74), [[r:1CO.16.6|1Co 16:6]] (cf. ἐν-, ὑπερ-εν-, ἐπι-, παρα-, συν-τυγχάνω).† τυχόν, adv., see: τυγχάνω (AS)

G5178.root: from a derivative of [[w:G5180]] (meaning a drum, "tympanum")
G5178.strongs: to stretch on an instrument of torture resembling a drum, and thus beat to death
senses: to torture by beating, beat to death (cf. Westc. on He, l.with): pass., [[r:HEB.11.35|Heb 11:35.]]† (AS)

G5179.strongs: a die (as struck), i.e. (by implication) a stamp or scar; by analogy, a shape, i.e. a statue, (figuratively) style or resemblance; specially, a sampler ("type"), i.e. a model (for imitation) or instance (for warning)
G5179.kjv: en-(ex-)ample, fashion, figure, form, manner, pattern, print
senses: the mark of a blow: τῶν ἥλων, [[r:JHN.20.25|Jhn 20:25.]]
An impression, impress, the stamp made by a die; hence, a figure, image: [[r:ACT.7.43|Act 7:43]] (LXX).
form (Plat.): [[r:ROM.6.17|Rom 6:17]]; the sense or substance of a letter (3Mac, l.with), [[r:ACT.23.25|Act 23:25.]]

an example, pattern: [[r:ACT.7.44|Act 7:44]], [[r:HEB.8.6|Heb 8:6]]" (LXX); in ethical sense, [[r:PHP.3.17|Php 3:17]], [[r:1TH.1.7|1Th 1:7]], [[r:2TH.3.9|2Th 3:9]], [[r:1TI.4.12|1Ti 4:12]], [[r:TIT.2.7|Tit 2:7]], [[r:1PE.5.3|1Pe 5:3]]; in doctrinal sense, type (see ICC, in l), [[r:ROM.5.14|Rom 5:14.]]† τυπικῶς, adv. (τύπος),

G5180.root: a primary verb (in a strengthened form)
G5180.strongs: to "thump", i.e. cudgel or pummel (properly, with a stick or bastinado), but in any case by repeated blows; thus differing from and, which denote a (usually single) blow with the hand or any instrument, or with the fist (or a hammer), or with the palm; as well as from, an accidental collision); by implication, to punish; figuratively, to offend (the conscience)
senses: τύπτω to strike, smite, beat: with accusative, [[r:MAT.24.49|Mat 24:49]], [[r:MRK.15.19|Mrk 15:19]], [[r:LUK.12.45|Luk 12:45]], [[r:ACT.18.17|Act 18:17 21:32 23:2-3]]; of mourners, τὰ στήθη, [[r:LUK.18.13|Luk 18:13 23:48]]; ἐπὶ τ. σιαγόνα, [[r:LUK.6.29|Luk 6:29]]; εἰς τ. κεφαλήν, [[r:MAT.27.30|Mat 27:30.]] Metaphorical, of God inflicting evil: [[r:ACT.23.3|Act 23:3]] (cf. [[r:EXO.8.2|Exo 8:2]], [[r:EZK.7.9|Eze 7:9]], al.); of disquieting conscience, [[r:1CO.8.12|1Co 8:12.]]† (AS)

G5181.root: a provincial form of the derivative of the base of [[w:G2962]]
senses: 1. an absolute sovereign , unlimited by law or constitution, (Herdotus Historicus), etc.: not applied to old hereditary sovereignties βασιλεῖαι); such as those of (Homer) or of Sparta; for the term rather regards the irregular way in which the power was gained , than the way in which it was exercised , being applied to the mild Pisistratus, but not to the despotic kings of Persia. However, the word soon came to imply reproach, like our tyrant , (Plato Philosophus), etc. 2. in a wider sense, the tyrant's son , or any member of his family , (Sophocles Tragicus):—;so, ἡ τύραννος was both the queen herself or a princess , (Euripides) 3. τύραννος, ον, as adjective kingly, royal , [variant datesTragica Adespota 4. imperious, despotic , (Thucydides); τύραννα δρᾶν (Sophocles Tragicus) τύραννος is probably from same Root as κύριος, κοίρανος. (ML)

G5183.strongs: a Tyrian, i.e. inhabitant of Tyrus

G5184.root: of Hebrew origin ([[w:H6865]]): Tyrus (i.e. Tsor), a place in Palestine

G5185.strongs: opaque (as if smoky), i.e. (by analogy) blind (physically or mentally)

G5186.strongs: to make blind, i.e. (figuratively) to obscure

G5187.strongs: to envelop with smoke, i.e. (figuratively) to inflate with self-conceit

G5188.strongs: to make a smoke, i.e. slowly consume without flame
senses: (τῦφος, smoke), to raise a smoke; pass., to smoke: [[r:MAT.12.20|Mat 12:20]] (LXX, καπνιζόμενον).† (AS)

G5192.strongs: the "hyacinth" or "jacinth", i.e. some gem of a deep blue color, probably the zirkon
senses: in cl., a flower, prob. the dark blue iris;
in late writers, a precious stone of the same colour, perhaps the sapphire: [[r:REV.21.20|Rev 21:20]] (Phil., FlJ, al.).† (AS)

G5194.root: perhaps from the same as [[w:G5205]] (as being transparent like rain)

senses: intrans., to wax wanton, run riot.
Trans., to outrage, insult, treat insolently: with accusative of person(s), [[r:MAT.22.6|Mat 22:6]], [[r:LUK.11.45|Luk 11:45 18:32]], [[r:ACT.14.5|Act 14:5]], [[r:1TH.2.2|1Th 2:2]].† (AS)
= ὕβρισμα, an act of wanton violence, an outrage, injury: [[r:2CO.12.10|2Co 12:10]]; metaphorically, of a loss by sea (find.), [[r:ACT.27.10|Act 27:10, 21]] (see MM, xxv).† (AS)
(ὑβρίζω), a violent, insolent man: [[r:ROM.1.20|Rom 1:20]], [[r:1TI.1.13|1Ti 1:13]] (EV, injurious).† SYN.: ἀλαζών, ὑπερήφανος, see Tr., Syn., § xxix (AS)

G5199.strongs: healthy, i.e. well (in body); figuratively, true (in doctrine)
senses: sound, whole, healthy: [[r:MAT.12.13|Mat 12:13 15:31]], Jhn.5:, 6, 9, 11, 14, 15 7:23, [[r:ACT.4.10|Act 4:10]]; before ἀπό, [[r:MRK.5.34|Mrk 5:34]]; of words, opinions, etc. (as in cl.), metaphorically, λόγος, [[r:TIT.2.8|Tit 2:8.]]† (AS)

G5104.root: probably for the dative case of [[w:G3588]]
G5104.strongs: an enclitic particle of asseveration by way of contrast; in sooth
G5104.kjv: (used only with other particles in the comparative, as,,,, etc
senses: 1. enclit. Particle, serving to express belief in an assertion, let me tell you, surely, verily , used to express an inference, then, consequently , (Homer); and in [variant datesTragica Adespota, to introduce a general sentiment. 2. to strengthen other Particles, γάρ τοι, ἤτοι, καίτοι, μέντοι, τοιγάρτοι, etc.: compare τἆρα, τἄν, μεντἄν.
